evidence.details: Single-episode and continuous-taskset runners call AlfworldApplicationEntry with typed RunRequest. The benchmark runner no longer imports or constructs LLMClient, model-facing registry, dispatcher, or agent runtime; environment lifecycle and scoring remain benchmark-owned.

Initial requests contain no image. Explicit observe is committed only on the next successful frozen provider request, same-response observe plus mutation is rejected, action invalidates current binding, retries do not recapture, and taskset boundaries remove historical image blocks while preserving text history.

Provider-attempt and model-view correlation remain isolated across taskset subtasks. Terminal tool-call ID and a content-hashed trace-row evidence reference persist in episode summaries; setup/control/model/total action accounting and borrowed adapter ownership remain reconciled.

Machine runner binds candidate SHA, locked four-row manifest and bytes, exact runtime profile, sanitized provider identity, artifact hashes, provider attempts, reset evidence, terminal IDs and outcomes. The independent verifier recomputes all counts; migration permits task failures while release requires 4/4, and both fail closed on incomplete or inconsistent evidence.

Release/AST gate: 28 passed in the final pre-commit rerun. Earlier focused runner/M0/compaction gate: 26 passed; ALFWorld benchmarking: 348 passed; application/tools/observation: 148 passed; full non-live: 1070 passed, 7 deselected, with one existing Starlette/httpx warning. Ruff, compileall, and diff check pass.

Per user direction, Xorg/THOR/ALFWorld/real-provider execution is deferred to one concentrated hkust4 batch using conda run -n hm_alfworld after Git sync of an exact committed SHA. No live completion claim is made.
The one allowed independent CL-11/12/13 grouped review is the next gate. It may run once; remediation will be verified without requesting a second grouped review.
